read.en: People live in all kinds of homes.
read.cn: 人们住在各种各样的房子里。

read.en: Some live in flats and some live in houses.
read.cn: 有些人住在公寓里，有些人住在房子里。

read.en: Some homes are big, and some are small.
read.cn: 有些房子很大，有些很小。

read.en: Cities: There are a lot of people, streets and big buildings in cities.
read.cn: 城市：城市里有许多人、街道和高大的建筑物。

read.en: Many people live in flats.
The country: In the country, there are farms.
People live in houses.
Homes are in neighbourhoods.
Some neighbourhoods are in cities, and some are in the country.
read.cn: 有些社区在城市里，有些在乡村。

read.en: Where do you live, Ningning?
Ningning: I live in Shenzhen. Shenzhen is a big city.
read.cn: 宁宁：我住在深圳。深圳是一座大城市。

read.en: Where do you live, Kate?
Kate: I live on a farm in the country.
read.cn: 凯特：我住在乡村的一个农场里。

read.en: City Mouse (M1) lives in a city.
read.cn: 城市老鼠（M1）住在一座城市里。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · City Mouse and Country Mouse

read.en: M1: There are too many people and cars here. Let me visit my friend in the country.
read.cn: M1：这里的人和车太多了。让我去乡村看望我的朋友吧。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · City Mouse and Country Mouse

read.en: City Mouse goes to visit his friend, Country Mouse (M2).
read.cn: 城市老鼠去看望他的朋友——乡村老鼠（M2）。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · City Mouse and Country Mouse

read.en: M2: Welcome to my home!
read.st: 拓展阅读 · City Mouse and Country Mouse

read.en: In the city, they eat some nice food.
read.cn: 在城市里，他们吃一些美味的食物。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · City Mouse and Country Mouse

read.en: M1: Have some cheese.
read.st: 拓展阅读 · City Mouse and Country Mouse

read.en: M2: Yummy, yummy!
read.st: 拓展阅读 · City Mouse and Country Mouse

read.en: M1: A big cat! Run!
read.st: 拓展阅读 · City Mouse and Country Mouse

read.en: M2: Come with me to the country. It's safe there.
read.cn: M2：跟我到乡下去吧。那里很安全。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · City Mouse and Country Mouse

read.en: Now they are safe. In the country, they eat apples for dinner.
read.cn: 现在他们安全了。在乡村，他们晚餐吃苹果。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · City Mouse and Country Mouse

read.en: M1: It's quiet here, but it's not fun. Come with me to the city!
read.cn: M1：这里很安静，可是没有意思。跟我到城里去吧！
read.st: 拓展阅读 · City Mouse and Country Mouse

read.en: M2: OK.
read.st: 拓展阅读 · City Mouse and Country Mouse

read.en: M1: Oh no. The country is good for you, but the city is good for me.
read.cn: M1：哦，不。乡村适合你，可是城市才适合我。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · City Mouse and Country Mouse

read.en: The two mice say goodbye. They go back to their homes.
read.cn: 两只老鼠道了别。他们各自回到自己的家。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · City Mouse and Country Mouse

read.en: Eagles live in big nests.
read.cn: 老鹰住在大大的巢穴里。

read.en: Where are their nests?
They are in the trees.
Some eagles are white and brown.
read.cn: 有些老鹰是白色和棕色的。

read.en: They eat rabbits, frogs and birds.
Where do owls live?
They live in tree holes.
They are safe there.
Owls come out at night.
They eat mice and snakes.
Honeybees live in a hive.
There, they make honey.
They have food in winter.
Honeybees have five eyes.
They can't see the colour red.
A panda mum has a baby in a panda centre.
read.cn: 熊猫妈妈在熊猫中心生了一个宝宝。

read.en: People take care of him.
They call him Taotao.
Taotao is one year old.
He loves his mum.
Where is Taotao?
He is up in a tree.
Taotao now lives in the wild.
That is amazing!
Wow! Taotao is now a big, strong panda.
read.cn: 哇！桃桃现在是一只又大多强壮的熊猫。

read.en: Look at the numbers.
Some numbers are even, and some numbers are odd.
read.cn: 有些数字是偶数，有些数字是奇数。

read.en: The even numbers are blue, and the odd numbers are red.
read.cn: 偶数是蓝色的，奇数是红色的。

read.en: We use numbers every day.
They help us count things.
You have five orange pencils.
I have six green pencils.
How many pencils do we have?
read.cn: 我们一共有多少支铅笔？

read.en: We have eleven pencils.
We say, "Five plus six equals eleven."
read.cn: 我们说：“五加六等于十一。”

read.en: You have five apples.
Your sister comes and eats one apple.
read.cn: 你姐姐过来吃掉了其中一个苹果。

read.en: Now how many apples do you have?
I have four apples now.
We say, "Five minus one equals four."
How old are you?
read.st: 拓展阅读 · Numbers in our lives

read.en: What's the time?
read.st: 拓展阅读 · Numbers in our lives

read.en: We use numbers all the time.
read.cn: 我们一直都在使用数字。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · Numbers in our lives

read.en: We use numbers to tell the time.
read.st: 拓展阅读 · Numbers in our lives

read.en: The numbers on the clock help us know the time.
read.cn: 钟面上的数字帮助我们知道时间。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · Numbers in our lives

read.en: We call people on their phone numbers.
read.cn: 我们按别人的电话号码给他们打电话。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · Numbers in our lives

read.en: Then we can talk to them on the phone.
read.cn: 然后我们就能和他们通电话了。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · Numbers in our lives

read.en: We use numbers in the supermarket.
read.cn: 我们在超市里使用数字。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · Numbers in our lives

read.en: Everything in the supermarket has a price.
read.cn: 超市里的每样东西都有一个价格。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · Numbers in our lives

read.en: Mum: We need to buy some food.
read.cn: 妈妈：我们需要买一些食物。

read.en: Dad: Let's play a game. We have 60 yuan.
read.cn: 爸爸：我们来玩个游戏。我们有60元。

read.en: Dad: Here's the shopping list for each team.
read.cn: 爸爸：这是每队的购物单。

read.en: Dad: The faster team can buy some candy.
read.cn: 爸爸：快一点的那队可以买些糖果。

read.en: Mum: We need some bread and a box of eggs.
read.cn: 妈妈：我们需要一些面包和一盒鸡蛋。

read.en: Chen Lei: Here they are.
Mum: How much are the eggs?
Chen Lei: They're 15 yuan. And the bread is 12 yuan.
Dad: We need some apples.
read.cn: 爸爸：我们需要一些苹果。

read.en: Chen Wei: Here they are.
Dad: All right. And some carrots.
read.cn: 爸爸：好的。还要一些胡萝卜。

read.en: Chen Wei: OK!
Dad: Great. How much are they?
read.cn: 爸爸：太好了。它们多少钱？

read.en: Chen Wei: This bag of apples is 12 yuan. This bag of carrots is 5 yuan.
read.cn: 陈伟：这袋苹果12元。这袋胡萝卜5元。

read.en: Chen Lei: We win, Mum!
Mum: We still have 16 yuan. What would you like, Chen Lei?
read.cn: 妈妈：我们还有16元。陈雷，你想要什么？

read.en: Chen Lei: I'd like a bar of chocolate. I can share it with you all.
read.cn: 陈雷：我想要一块巧克力。我可以和大家一起分享。

read.en: Chen Wei: Thanks!
Farmer Thomas has a cow. It gives milk every day.
read.cn: 托马斯农夫有一头奶牛。它每天都产奶。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The farmer and the dress

read.en: His wife, Rosa, sells the milk.
read.cn: 他的妻子罗莎把奶卖掉。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The farmer and the dress

read.en: One day, Thomas asks Rosa to go to a dance.
read.cn: 一天，托马斯请罗莎去参加舞会。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The farmer and the dress

read.en: "No," says Rosa, "I don't have a dress."
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The farmer and the dress

read.en: Thomas has an idea. He sells the cow and buys a beautiful dress for Rosa.
read.cn: 托马斯有了个主意。他卖了奶牛，给罗莎买了一条漂亮的连衣裙。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The farmer and the dress

read.en: "Look at the new dress, Rosa. We can go to the dance now," he says.
read.cn: "看这条新裙子，罗莎。我们现在可以去跳舞了，"他说。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The farmer and the dress

read.en: Rosa is angry!
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The farmer and the dress

read.en: "Our cow gives us milk every day. We sell the milk and buy food!
read.cn: "我们的奶牛每天给我们奶。我们卖了奶买食物！
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The farmer and the dress

read.en: We can't eat the dress. We need our cow!"
read.cn: 裙子不能吃。我们需要我们的奶牛！"
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The farmer and the dress

read.en: Thomas buys his cow back.
read.cn: 托马斯把他的奶牛买了回来。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The farmer and the dress

read.en: There are four seasons in a year: spring, summer, autumn and winter.
read.cn: 一年有四个季节：春天、夏天、秋天和冬天。

read.en: Spring is a season for growing.
read.cn: 春天是一个生长（万物生长）的季节。

read.en: It gets warm.
It usually rains a lot.
The rain helps plants grow.
Summer comes after spring.
It gets hot.
The days are long and the nights are short.
The sun helps fruit and flowers grow.
read.cn: 阳光帮助果实和花朵生长。

read.en: Autumn comes after summer.
It gets cool.
Leaves turn red, yellow and orange.
read.cn: 树叶变成红色、黄色和橙色。

read.en: Winter comes after autumn.
The days are short and the nights are long.
It gets cold and it often snows!
read.cn: 天气变冷，而且常常下雪！

read.en: Many trees don't have leaves.
Then it's spring!
The seasons begin again.
My name is Arnold.
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The seasons of Arnold's apple tree

read.en: I have an apple tree.
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The seasons of Arnold's apple tree

read.en: It's spring.
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The seasons of Arnold's apple tree

read.en: There are lots of flowers on my apple tree.
read.cn: 我的苹果树上有许多花儿。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The seasons of Arnold's apple tree

read.en: Honeybees look for food.
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The seasons of Arnold's apple tree

read.en: It's summer.
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The seasons of Arnold's apple tree

read.en: I build a tree house in my apple tree.
read.cn: 我在我的苹果树上搭了一座树屋。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The seasons of Arnold's apple tree

read.en: I watch small apples grow.
read.cn: 我看着小苹果慢慢生长。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The seasons of Arnold's apple tree

read.en: It's autumn.
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The seasons of Arnold's apple tree

read.en: My apple tree now has big, red apples.
read.cn: 我的苹果树现在结满了大大的红苹果。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The seasons of Arnold's apple tree

read.en: My family and I make apple pies.
read.cn: 我和家人一起做苹果派。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The seasons of Arnold's apple tree

read.en: It's winter.
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The seasons of Arnold's apple tree

read.en: There is lots of snow.
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The seasons of Arnold's apple tree

read.en: I make a snowman.
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The seasons of Arnold's apple tree

read.en: There are no leaves on the apple tree now.
read.cn: 现在苹果树上一片叶子也没有了。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The seasons of Arnold's apple tree

read.en: I have some small black sunflower seeds.
read.cn: 我有一些小小的黑色向日葵种子。

read.en: I put a seed in the soil.
read.cn: 我把一粒种子放进土壤里。

read.en: Mum waters it.
Now the plant has some green leaves.
read.cn: 现在这株植物有一些绿色的叶子了。

read.en: But I can’t see the roots.
They grow down.
Now my sunflower is tall with a big yellow flower.
read.cn: 现在我的向日葵长得很高，开着一朵大大的黄花。

read.en: The flower is round.
My family love it.
My sunflower has a lot of seeds.
read.cn: 我的向日葵结了很多种子。

read.en: People can make oil from the seeds.
read.cn: 人们可以用这些种子榨油。

read.en: Sunflowers are amazing!
Carrots are good to eat.
We can make carrot juice and carrot cake.
read.cn: 我们可以做胡萝卜汁和胡萝卜蛋糕。

read.en: Carrots are good for our eyes.
read.cn: 胡萝卜对我们的眼睛有好处。

read.en: Many people like tomatoes.
Some people grow them at home.
We can use tomatoes to make soup and salad.
read.cn: 我们可以用番茄做汤和沙拉。

read.en: Mint has a special taste.
read.cn: 薄荷有一种特别的味道。

read.en: We can drink mint tea or eat mint candy.
read.cn: 我们可以喝薄荷茶或吃薄荷糖。

read.en: We also have mint ice cream.

units.name: Unit 7
units.title: 道路安全
units.en: How do we keep safe on the road?

read.en: Dad: The light is green. Let's cross the road. What should we do first?
read.cn: 爸爸：绿灯了。我们过马路吧。我们应该先做什么？
read.st: 课文 · Our way to school

read.en: Yaoyao: Look left! No cars.
read.st: 课文 · Our way to school

read.en: Qiqi: Look right! No cars.
read.st: 课文 · Our way to school

read.en: Yaoyao: It's safe to cross.
read.st: 课文 · Our way to school

read.en: Dad: Good job!
read.st: 课文 · Our way to school

read.en: Qiqi: I like walking to school.
read.cn: 琪琪：我喜欢走路去学校。

read.st: 课文 · Our way to school

read.en: Dad: No. Children under 12 years old can't ride on the road.
read.cn: 爸爸：不行。12岁以下的儿童不能在道路上骑车。
read.st: 课文 · Our way to school

read.en: Yaoyao: All right.
read.st: 课文 · Our way to school

read.en: Yaoyao: Look! The light is green.
read.st: 课文 · Our way to school

read.en: Qiqi: Hurry up!
read.st: 课文 · Our way to school

read.en: Dad: Don't run on the road, Qiqi.
read.cn: 爸爸：不要在马路上跑，琪琪。
read.st: 课文 · Our way to school

read.en: Dad: Oh no! We're late!
read.cn: 爸爸：哦，不！我们要迟到了！
read.st: 课文 · Our way to school

read.en: Yaoyao & Qiqi: Dad, walk! Don't run!
read.cn: 瑶瑶和琪琪：爸爸，走路！别跑！
read.st: 课文 · Our way to school

read.en: Yaoyao: Dad, can I skate to school?
read.cn: 瑶瑶：爸爸，我能滑滑板去学校吗？
read.st: 课文 · Our way to school

read.en: Qiqi: And can I skate?
read.st: 课文 · Our way to school

read.en: Dad: No, sorry, kids. We can't skate on the road. It's not safe.
read.cn: 爸爸：不行，抱歉，孩子们。我们不能在马路上滑滑板。那不安全。
read.st: 课文 · Our way to school

read.en: Traffic signs keep us safe on the road.
read.cn: 交通标志保障我们在马路上的安全。

read.en: What do these signs mean?
read.st: 拓展阅读 · Traffic signs around us

read.en: Don't turn left.
read.st: 拓展阅读 · Traffic signs around us

read.en: Some people are working on the road. Go a different way.
read.cn: 有些人在马路上施工。请走另一条路。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · Traffic signs around us

read.en: There's a school here. Slow down and be careful.
read.cn: 这里有学校。减速慢行，注意安全。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · Traffic signs around us

read.en: You can cross the road here.
read.st: 拓展阅读 · Traffic signs around us

read.en: I'm Junjun.
My sister and I are at our grandparents' house for a week.
read.cn: 我和妹妹在祖父母家待一个星期。

read.en: Our grandparents don't work now.
read.cn: 我们的祖父母现在不工作了。

read.en: Every morning, they go for a walk in the park.
read.cn: 每天早上，他们去公园散步。

read.en: They often do tai chi with their friends there.
read.cn: 他们常和朋友们在那里打太极拳。

read.en: Grandpa and Grandma do tai chi in the park.
read.cn: 爷爷和奶奶在公园打太极拳。

read.en: Grandma and I go shopping.
It's Sunday morning.
Grandma and I are in the supermarket.
She always goes shopping on Sundays.
Grandpa likes gardening.
In the afternoon, Grandpa usually does gardening.
He has lots of plants.
They look great.
Grandma has a food vlog.
read.cn: 奶奶有一个美食视频博客。

read.en: In the evening, Grandma shows us her food vlog.
read.cn: 晚上，奶奶给我们看她的美食视频博客。

read.en: Lots of people watch it.
This is a famous poem about the Double Ninth Festival.
read.cn: 这是一首关于重阳节的著名诗歌。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The Double Ninth Festival

read.en: On this day, families climb mountains together.
read.cn: 在这一天，家人们一起登高。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The Double Ninth Festival

read.en: They drink flower tea and eat Chongyang cakes.
read.cn: 他们喝菊花茶、吃重阳糕。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The Double Ninth Festival

read.en: People also visit their parents or grandparents.
read.cn: 人们也去看望自己的父母或祖父母。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The Double Ninth Festival

read.en: They bring them gifts and help them at home.
read.cn: 他们带礼物给他们，并在家帮助他们。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The Double Ninth Festival

read.en: Then they have a family dinner.
read.cn: 然后他们吃一顿家庭晚餐。
read.st: 拓展阅读 · The Double Ninth Festival
